privacy.title: Privacy & Philosophy
privacy.data_ownership_desc: BaiShou believes memory is an extension of the soul. Your journals are stored as open plain-text Markdown files and attachments in your local Vault, never locked into proprietary formats. The local SQLite database acts solely as a shadow index and search cache, which can be safely rebuilt from files at any time. Outside of your chosen AI and sync providers, BaiShou never collects or uploads your data.
privacy.local_first_desc: You can write smoothly even when completely offline. All AI companion interactions and summaries are triggered on-demand, connecting directly to your chosen AI providers or local models (e.g. Ollama). BaiShou runs without centralized relay servers, keeping your records and generated summaries entirely local and never using them for model training.
privacy.transparency_desc: BaiShou supports multi-device bidirectional incremental sync and full snapshot backups. Sync your vaults to self-hosted WebDAV (e.g. NAS, Nextcloud) or S3-compatible storage (e.g. Cloudflare R2, MinIO), or use Git version control on desktop. You can also export your entire memory archive via ZIP anytime for complete end-to-end sovereignty.

shortcut.create_skill_guide_prompt:
Guide me to create a software-level Skill (a reusable AI workflow pack).

Requirements:
- Ask only 1–2 key questions at a time, then continue based on my answers
- Confirm purpose and trigger first, then name and description, then the body
- The name must be kebab-case (lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens) and match the directory name
- The description should be third person and say what it does and when to use it
- Keep the body concise: only domain knowledge and steps the agent would not already know

When the information is enough:
1. Show me a full SKILL.md preview: start with properties metadata (name: and description: lines), and do not wrap them with ---
2. After I agree, call skill_write to save it as .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md in the user home directory (do not use workspace file tools, and do not write to AI/skills)
shortcut.create_skill_guide_prompt_workspace:
Guide me to create a project-level Skill (reusable only in the current workspace).

Requirements:
- Ask only 1–2 key questions at a time, then continue based on my answers
- Confirm purpose and trigger first, then name and description, then the body
- The name must be kebab-case (lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens) and match the directory name
- The description should be third person and say what it does and when to use it
- Keep the body concise: only domain knowledge and steps the agent would not already know

When the information is enough:
1. Show me a full SKILL.md preview: start with properties metadata (name: and description: lines), and do not wrap them with ---
2. After I agree, call skill_write to save it as .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md in the current workspace (do not use workspace file tools, and do not write to AI/skills)
shortcut.manager_panel_hint: Browse, edit, or delete existing skills here. Or choose Create Skill from the + menu to let the AI guide you step by step. Type / in an empty input to match and insert a skill.
